raw_microdata.name: Comedy Plex Presents: Matt Torres
raw_microdata.description: Matt Torres A Chicago Native, Comedian, Actor, and Veteran of the Iraq War. Matthew has been through it all, which is how he developed his sense of humor. From the Southside of Chicago, to his time in the Marines. He has used Comedy as a tool to make the best out of life’s worst situations. Matt has also made appearances on such television shows as Justified, Shameless, and Criminal Minds. *2 Drink Minimum Per Person *21 and over unless accompanied by an adult *Outside food welcome *Parking at Holley Court Garage (next to club)

matched_descriptions_with_dollar.name: The Workshop Open Mic Night - Sept 28th
matched_descriptions_with_dollar.description:
START YOUR WEEK WITH SOMETHING UNEXPECTED. 

The Workshop is Calgary’s most dynamic Monday night comedy show — a curated open mic blending the polish of seasoned professionals with the raw energy of fresh new voices.

$5.99 Wild Rose Pints all ight every Monday

Each week features a professional headliner, surprise sets from touring comics, and a rotating cast of local comedians trying out new material — including the occasional brave soul taking the stage for the very first time.

Whether you’re a comedy aficionado or just looking for a memorable night out, The Workshop offers smart, spontaneous entertainment in the heart of the city.

Tickets $15 | Show at 7:30 PM
